[[File:Geyser.jpg|thumb|right|250px|A geyser bursts forth on Maryx Minor.]]
{{Listen|filename=Geyser-SWE1R.flac|title=Geyser-SWE1R.flac|description=Sound of a geyser venting}}
'''Geysers''' were a natural phenomenon in which underground [[Water/Legends|water]] was heated by [[Volcano/Legends|volcanic]] [[rock]]. When the water boiled, the resulting pressure forced it through crevasses until it spouted above ground in tall columns of vapor. Multiple geysers were often found in fields, creating a hazard.<ref name="JS">''[[Jedi Search]]''</ref>

==Notable geysers==
The [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kodai]] had a large geyser. [[Murk Lundi]] traveled to the planet to recover a [[Sith holocron/Legends|Sith holocron]], but was foiled by his student [[Omal]] who caused the holocron to be lost within the geyser.<ref name="Jedi Apprentice Special Edition: The Followers">''[[Jedi Apprentice Special Edition: The Followers]]''</ref>

The planet [[Florrum/Legends|Florrum]] had many [[Acid/Legends|acid]] geysers on the [[Doshar fields/Legends|Doshar fields]]. [[Skalder/Legends|Skalders]], creatures native to the desert region, had thick hides to protect themselves from the often spewing acid.<ref name="The Gungan General">{{TCW|The Gungan General}}</ref>

The planet [[Akuria II]] had a field of geysers underneath a body of water. Known as the [[Geyser Sea]], the water was heated by the geyser field. The geysers there were also used to heat the [[Akuria Rebel Base|Snow Structure]], a small [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] base on the planet.<ref name="KOI">''[[The Kingdom of Ice]]''</ref> [[Demonsgate]], in the [[Kathol sector/Legends|Kathol sector]] had a number of geyser fields. In one such field, [[Makezh]], a member of the ''[[FarStar]]'' was ambushed by [[Mist (bounty hunter)|Mist]] and a unit of [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]].<ref name="Showdown adventure">{{DarkStryder|adventure=Showdown (The Kathol Rift)|book=The Kathol Rift}}</ref> On the volcanic planet [[Maryx Minor/Legends|Maryx Minor]], the [[Ancient Order of Pessimists]] maintained a hermitage near a geyser field.<ref name="Star Wars: Boba Fett: Enemy of the Empire">''[[Star Wars: Boba Fett: Enemy of the Empire]]''</ref>

The planet [[Eol Sha]] also had a field of geysers near the planet's abandoned colony. [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] was taken deep into a geyser by Eol Sha colony leader [[Gantoris]], ostensibly to gather [[Eol Sha lichen|lichen]] there, but in actuality as a test of his [[The Force/Legends|Force]] abilities. Skywalker escaped the geyser, using the Force to protect himself from the super-heated vapor.<ref name="JS" /> The planet [[Baroonda/Legends|Baroonda]] had a number of [[Sulfur/Legends|sulfur]] geyser fields&mdash;most notably the [[Hoodu Geyser Fields]]<ref name="Star Wars: Episode I Racer">[[Star Wars: Episode I Racer|''Star Wars'': Episode I ''Racer'']]</ref>&mdash;while a number of sulphur geysers existed within the [[Sulphur Pits of Vulcar|Sulphur Pits]] of [[Vulcar]].<ref name="Droids 1986 1">[[Droids (1986) 1|''Droids'' (1986) 1]]</ref> The planet [[Togominda/Legends|Togominda]] was known for its [[salt geyser]]s.<ref name="Galactic Gazetteer: Hoth and the Greater Javin">{{Wizards|url=default.asp?x=starwars/article/sw20040325web|text=Galactic Gazetteer: Hoth and the Greater Javin|int=Galactic Gazetteer: Hoth and the Greater Javin}}</ref> There were ice geysers on the planet [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]] that dotted the landscape. These were known to be quite beautiful and were recreated in [[scenic replicator]]s in the [[Arcade Omicron]] [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]] on the planet [[Bescane/Legends|Bescane]].<ref name="DH">{{JournalCite|9|Death-Hunter}}, p.199</ref> The region around the [[Iron Tower]] on [[Aridus/Legends|Aridus]] also had geysers.<ref name="The Return of Ben Kenobi">"[[The Return of Ben Kenobi]]"</ref>
